reviews.t: Really great starter brush that should last a while.
reviews.x: I've had 4 brushes now and have been wet shaving for 8 years. I was concerned that this was going to be too small in my hand or too light as I had a Parker before that was significantly heavy and had a nice sized bulb on it.  This is lighter than that, but not too light. It is smaller than others I've had but not too light. The bristles are a bit stiffer than others that I've had, but I've realised that the stiffer bristles are much better for shaving soap that I use, where the softer bristles a

reviews.t: Big Full Brush at a Fair Price
reviews.x: I have been using a shaving brush for a little over five years now.  The first brush I purchased was in a starter pack from the art of shaving.  This summer I decided that I needed to upgrade my brush.  The Beau Brummell was on sale so I decided to give it a try.  My first impression was that the brush was much bigger than the my original brush (see pictures below) with a much fuller brush.  The bristles feel about the same... it's soft with stiffish bristles.  I've never liked the brushes where

reviews.t: Very soft brush with a great lather!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:6e76d7c3b23dfe32cb1019f6175a0f49]] My first thought this is brush is that the bristle's were far softer than my other badger shaving brush. The weight of this brush fall about in the center instead of at the end of the brush. I will say this gave the entire brush a less quality feel to it. The brush is made of hard plastic though so considering that it felt more quality than I was expecting.  As for actual use the brush lathered the soap very quickly and the soap was nice a thick (see

reviews.t: Good Brush at Affordable Price
reviews.x: Pros: - Handle is very comfortable - Hairs are soft and feel nice on the face - This brush applies much more lather to my face than my boars hair brush  Cons: - The hair was dirty upon receipt of the brush. I had to rinse the hairs thoroughly before my first lather. - I estimate that around 15-20 hairs came loose on the first shave. If this persists it will be a problem but so far it seems it was just a result of breaking in the brush.  I found the Beau Brummell brush to be much softer than a bo

reviews.t: Sheds like a German Shepard
reviews.x: Updated review - after using for past year plus, it is starting to lose bristles like crazy.  They end up in sink, on my face, in drain (hope it doesn't clog).  I have never had a brush shed like this before so very disappointing.  Otherwise, it is very durable and soft.  I really enjoyed it at first but would think it would last longer.  I have had other brushes last for years.  Original Review Super soft with minimal break in.  I let it sit in hot water for about 10 minutes and by the 2nd shav

reviews.t: Looks great and works great too!
reviews.x: I should start by saying that I'm very new to the quality shaving products world. I got myself set up with a de safety razor starter kit just over a month ago at this point so I'm very much still trying out products to find what works best for me. This brush is miles and miles above the cheap synthetic one that I've been using. Right out of the box this thing just looks high quality. Everything about it just says premium. Definitely something I have no problem keeping on display in my bathroom.

reviews.t: This brush creates a wonderful later and so far
reviews.x: This brush ended up being a little larger than I expected, but I'm not complaining about having more quality bristles in my life! This brush creates a wonderful later and so far, after one week of use, I've seen zero fall out. The price point is a little lower because of the plastic handle. I won't lie and say the handle is amazing, it's standard. It's made of a hard plastic and it gets the job done. The most important part are the hair which are certainly 100% pure and real. They preform great!

reviews.t: ... using a shaving brush and soap so I was pretty excited about trying this brush for the first time
reviews.x: I'm new to using a shaving brush and soap so I was pretty excited about trying this brush for the first time. It seems like a good quality brush to a novice like me. It fit  in the stand that I bought for my razor, it didn't smell like a wet badger, and it didn't shed but one small hair while I was lathering the soap. My technique needs some work but the brush seems just right.

reviews.t: Certainly worth buying!
reviews.x: The brush seemed a little stiff when it arrived. However, while using the brush, the bristles quickly activated and provided a even smooth spread of shaving cream. I observed nothing that would prevent me from purchasing the brush again. At this point, there would be no reason to choose a more costly brush over the Beau Brummell. Needless to say, I'm satisfied with the brush!

reviews.t: A fine shaving brush.
reviews.x: After pre-soaking the bristles of this brush for a few moments it's ready to use.  The brush lathers up the shaving soap very well and gently foams it onto my face.  I use circular motions to get the shaving soap from the brush under the bristles on my face.  The brush maintains its shape when dry, is light yet sturdy, lathers well and feels good on the face.

reviews.t: Ok brush at this price point.
reviews.x: I noticed some other reviews talking about the brush being dirty when they received it.  Mine didn't seem to be although I did shampoo it once before I used it.  I have a couple other brushes in this price range.  The brush head seems to be the same size and consistency of my other two brushes.  The handle is a little shorter than one (same length as the other) and narrower/thinner than the handle on both my other brushes.  Not horrible but just a little smaller than I was used to.  The first co

reviews.t: Excellent Beginners Shave Brush
reviews.x: The Beau Brummell Shaving Brush is an absolute dream to shave with.  Today was my first DE shave, and the brush performed pretty well with no experience on using a shave brush.  I received the brush yesterday, and decided to follow a tip I'd found to help break in a brush.  To remove the scent, fill up a bowl or cup with hot water and a few drops of dish soap.  Let your brush soak in the dish soap for about five minutes, and rinse the brush out until no soap remains.  This will also help knock o

reviews.t: Great value brush
reviews.x: This is my first black badger brush, I have brushes in other grades. Silvertip is, of course, the gold standard. This little fellow holds up well with, perhaps, a little more spine than my high end brush. I did lose a bristle on the first use, but so far, nothing else. The initial badger funk was a bit stronger than I'm used to, but after soaking and one use it's down to a very manageable level. I used it with an Arko puck. It produced tons of lather quickly with very little pressure and the bru

reviews.t: Two and a half monthes of use & the brisles are shedding worse than the dogs coat.
reviews.x: I tried a brush set from Target to see if I liked the idea of shaving using a soap dish & brush. I bought this one thinking it was of good quality. I have used the brush since August this year. The bristles are coming out of the brush and leave enough in the soap cup, looking worse than the dogs bed. Shaving again today I have a great deal of bristles all over my face along with the lather. As far as I'm concerned, the cheaper Target brush worked better than this one. The cheep Target brush did

reviews.t: ... a review until I have given the product a good workout. however
reviews.x: So far I have only had the opportunity  to use this brush a few times and I usually don't write a review until I have given the product a good workout. however, I thought I would give this one a go since I have noticed that it is loosing hairs already. I noticed in the reviews that others had the similar issue. This one issue is a little disappointing because this really is an exceptional brush. I really love the feel of the drush soft and smooth. has a nice handle and the size is perfect. There

reviews.t: Wow!
reviews.x: For years I've lathered up for shaving with a basic drugstore shaving brush.  Never again!  It's ridiculous how good a shave feels using this brush.  Lathering up feels great, and the shaving soap really does surround and lubricate better using badger hair.  I've got fairly large hands, and the brush fits my hand quite well.  I bought it to fit in the Chrome Razor and Shaving Brush Stand, and it fits perfectly.  I chose it for the design and for the resin handle, which I expect to last longer th

reviews.t: Good quality product at a reasonable price.
reviews.x: I have only been using the Beau Brummell shaving brush for about a week, great value for the price. I'm just getting back to wet shaving after a long absence. This brush holds a good amount of moisture for working up a thick lather and does a very nice job of working the lather into my whiskers.  It appears to be a good quality product at a reasonable price. What more can you ask? As with any natural shaving brush it takes a while to "break in", so I'm expecting the results will be even

reviews.t: Great brush.
reviews.x: As a first time straight razor user I was looking for a good shaving brush, I stumbled onto this one while I was shopping and decided to give it a try. This brush produces a great foam when using shaving soap, it's thick and rich and feels great on the skin. The one down side I would be aware of is, the brush has a gamy smell most likely due to it being badger fur. I rinsed mine two or three times in hot sink water and the smell was reduced and only slightly noticeable.

reviews.t: Kiss me.
reviews.x: Awesome piece indeed.  This is my second brush.  I bought it as I thought my first one was too old.  I asked other fellow amazonians and many said that they don't age as long as one takes good care.  I am glad I did get this one, though.  * Soft on the skin * Shed does occur but minimal * Makes great foam * I like the handle finishing (my first one's handle was damaged by water; pealing of coating).  I totally recommend it and would buy again, for self and as gifts.

reviews.t: I have had some that shed like my dog in spring and others much less so
reviews.x: It is probably fair to say that all new badger bristle brushes shed a bit at first.  I have had some that shed like my dog in spring and others much less so.  this one does not seem to shed at all. A few broken strands at first but nothing else.  Works very well, I am very happy with it  Not the cheapest thing out there but probably the best thing out there for the price

reviews.t: Long lasting
reviews.x: I've had other badger brushes, but they tend to not last very long. In the past I have gotten ones with wooden handles and the clear coating on the handle always ends up chipping and flaking.  This Beau Brummell brush is the best one I've used so far and I've had4-5 over the past 2 years. I will be buying these for Christmas presents for sure.

reviews.t: I was disappointed with this badger brush
reviews.x: I am somewhat of a newbie to wet shaving...app 2 years...I was disappointed with this badger brush. For ME, the brush was too prickly in comparison to the boars hair brush I  have been using. Although it is not as firm as the boars hair, the prickly feeling is a game ender! The brush is attractive and seems well made....it's just not for me.

reviews.t: Same quality as luxury brand
reviews.x: I bought a similar product for my husband that costed 3 times as much. My husband could not tell that there was a difference until I pointed out that this was a different brand. When I probed him more about it, he said that the bristles gave him just the right amount of softness and thickness. He also said that this lathered really well.

reviews.t: Don't waste good money on a cheap brush
reviews.x: I was SPECIFICALLY looking for a shave brush that was made in the USA. When I got the product it says on the box made in PRC.  The search results turned up this as the top most related to my search terms. For those who don't know what that stands for, PRC=People's Republic of China. Total rip off. Don't waste good money on a cheap brush.

reviews.t: Great, Soft Brush!
reviews.x: Great brush! It is actually soft straight out of packing unlike other brands of the same price range. I got this brush to replace a $60 brush I received as a gift 9 years ago, and honestly I thought I would be disappointed, but I am not at all. This thing is brilliant and not any worse than the $60 brush at all. I love it so far!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brush soft and effective at building a good lather.
Several reviewers report the brush sheds or loses bristles, sometimes heavily over time.
Reviewers frequently describe it as a good value or affordable option, especially for beginners.
A few reviewers mention the brush arrived dirty or with an initial badger scent requiring washing.
Some reviewers note the brush is smaller or lighter than expected, though not necessarily a complaint.
